A role, a title, a boss, or an ambition you have been keeping quiet reaches the point where you either name what you want or watch the opening go to someone who asked.
lunation opening situation › 11
A friendship, a group project, a community role, or a plan built on shared effort is revealing who actually shows up and whose name is only on the list.
lunation opening situation › 12
A sleep pattern, an old grief, a private habit, or the invisible work nobody sees is taking more out of you than anything on your calendar.
lunation opening situation › 2
A paycheck, a bill, an invoice, or the question of what your time actually costs lands in cold numbers you can no longer explain away.
lunation opening situation › 3
A message you keep editing, a form you keep moving to tomorrow, or a conversation you have rescheduled three times is about to stop waiting.
lunation opening situation › 4
A lease, a repair, a parent's expectation, or the question of where you actually feel at home needs more than another temporary fix.
lunation opening situation › 5
A romance, a child, a creative project, or the question of what you actually enjoy deserves more than the scraps of energy left at the end of the day.
lunation opening situation › 6
A workload, a symptom, a schedule, or a workplace dynamic is showing you the exact price your body pays for how the days are set up.
lunation opening situation › 7
A partnership, a marriage, a business arrangement, or one specific person brings terms you agreed to years ago back into the light.
lunation opening situation › 8
A joint account, a debt, an inheritance, or a promise made behind closed doors is coming due, and someone else holds equal power over what happens next.
lunation opening situation › 9
A course, trip, application, publication, or long-term plan may be reaching the point where someone has to give a real answer.
lunation release › 1
Let go of managing how you come across. Release the version of you built for approval. Shed the reflex to shrink so nobody flinches. As those loosen, showing up gets easier than maintaining the image ever was.
lunation release › 10
Let go of chasing titles that impress people you do not respect. Release the fear of being seen as ambitious. Shed the work that costs more than it pays in every currency but money. As those loosen, your reputation starts matching your actual values.
lunation release › 11
Let go of friendships running on history alone. Release the need to be liked by every room. Shed the futures you are holding onto only because you announced them. As those loosen, your real people and real hopes get room to arrive.
lunation release › 12
Let go of the processing you do alone that never quite finishes. Release the guilt that has outlived its lesson. Shed the habit of disappearing when you need people most. As those loosen, rest starts actually resting you.
lunation release › 2
Let go of measuring your worth by productivity. Release the fear that enough will never arrive. Shed the spending that soothes instead of serves. As those loosen, money starts following what you value instead of what you fear.
lunation release › 3
Let go of saying yes before you check your week. Release the story you repeat about yourself that stopped being true. Shed the scrolling that eats the hours conversation deserves. As those loosen, your words start carrying weight again.
lunation release › 4
Let go of keeping the family peace at your own expense. Release the guilt about outgrowing where you came from. Shed the clutter, physical and emotional, that keeps home from feeling like yours. As those loosen, your foundation starts holding you up again.
lunation release › 5
Let go of saving joy for after the work is done. Release the fear of being seen trying. Shed the belief that your creativity needs to earn its keep. As those loosen, play starts feeding everything else you do.
lunation release › 6
Let go of running on empty and calling it dedication. Release the routine that serves the schedule but not the body. Shed the small daily self-abandonments: skipped meals, skipped walks, skipped rest. As those loosen, your days start working for you instead of on you.
lunation release › 7
Let go of keeping score in your closest relationships. Release the habit of saying it is fine when it is not. Shed the partnership patterns you inherited but never chose. As those loosen, the people who match you get easier to see.
lunation release › 8
Let go of controlling what was never yours to hold. Release the debt-keeping, emotional and financial. Shed the secret you are tired of carrying alone. As those loosen, trust stops feeling like a risk and starts feeling like relief.
lunation release › 9
Let go of beliefs you defend but no longer believe. Release the plan that made sense for a person you have outgrown. Shed the certainty that keeps you from asking better questions. As those loosen, the bigger picture starts drawing itself.
lunation ruler house › 1
the line gets drawn at you personally: your body, your limits, the version of you people deal with directly. Others register that you have stopped asking permission before you have finished explaining the change.
lunation ruler house › 10
your public standing is on the line: the job, the reputation, the title that enters the meeting before you do. A decision made in private now needs a public version.
lunation ruler house › 11
friends, organizations, professional contacts, and shared commitments are part of the answer. A goal everyone supported in theory may have quietly become your responsibility to carry
lunation ruler house › 12
rest, recovery, and the patterns running under your awareness take over. What has been working quietly in the background is due for daylight.
lunation ruler house › 2
money and self-worth set the limit: what this costs, what it pays, what you refuse to keep subsidizing. The budget is about to be the most honest voice in the conversation.
lunation ruler house › 3
the truth arrives through a text, an errand, a neighbor, a sibling. A casual exchange exposes the real dynamic under the pleasantries.
lunation ruler house › 4
home and family set the terms: the household, a parent, the place you return to when the day is over. The private arrangement is deciding the public question.
lunation ruler house › 5
what feeds you gets the vote: the romance, the child, the creative risk, the pleasure you keep postponing for work. Joy stops being negotiable here.
lunation ruler house › 6
the body and the schedule tell the truth: the daily tasks, the symptoms, the hours given away for free. That is all the evidence this decision needs.
lunation ruler house › 7
one other person holds the mirror: a partner, a client, an ex, a counterpart. Their reaction shows how much space this dynamic leaves for who you actually are.
lunation ruler house › 8
merged money and unspoken power shape the outcome: the joint account, the debt, the terms negotiated in private. Those terms are up for review in the open.
lunation ruler house › 9
the bigger frame is in charge: the course, the legal matter, the travel plan, the belief being tested. The hardest part is retiring a position you built your name on.
lunation ruler retro
Because {{rulerTitle}} is retrograde, this is less about taking on something new and more an inspection of what already exists: the standing arrangements, the roles nobody re-negotiated, who is actually carrying the weight.
lunation shows › 1
This is the fresh-start house: a new look, a new direction, a rebirth you can feel. It can show up as the urge to change your path, redirect your life, or step out as a newer version of yourself. The shell cracks so that version can emerge.
lunation shows › 10
It can show up as sudden changes in status, responsibility, or direction: career takes the front seat. Step back and check the long game, because whatever you pour energy into should align with your values and build toward your future.
lunation shows › 11
It can show up as renewal in your social networks: friendships changing, new communities forming, strength found in numbers. Surround yourself with people who inspire you, and be an active voice in the rooms you choose.
lunation shows › 12
It can show up as the need to tune out the world and tune in: rest, reflection, and hidden parts of the psyche surfacing to be healed. If you have been numbing yourself with busyness, this Moon calls you back to your truth.
lunation shows › 2
It can show up as money moving: reworking finances, revaluing your work, or behind-the-scenes effort finally getting noticed. How much you value yourself shows in what you are manifesting, so honoring your values is the real assignment.
lunation shows › 3
It can show up close to home: conversations with siblings and neighbors, a creative spark, or the pull to lean on your local circle. Support flows both ways right now, so connect with the people who keep your momentum going.
lunation shows › 4
It can show up as emotion asking for maintenance: feelings you have been holding start to build until they get processed. Checking in, feeling it fully, and letting it move through you is the actual work here; you cannot think your way out of emotion.
lunation shows › 5
It can show up as passion returning: an old hobby calling you back, romance warming, a creative project asking for attention. Reintegrating what you love, including the parts of yourself you abandoned along the way, is the point.
lunation shows › 6
It can show up as health and work routines shifting: new information challenges stuck patterns, and a new self-care rhythm wants building. If you have been giving too much, the focus swings back to you; flexibility is the best tool here.
lunation shows › 7
It can show up as relationship issues finally surfacing for resolution, or at least discussion: reciprocity, commitment, and who belongs in your life. What you need from others has to balance with what they can actually give.
lunation shows › 8
It can show up as power dynamics arising for change: trust, intimacy, debts, and shared resources on the table. What you thought gave you security may not anymore, and your deeper inner resources are what pull you through.
lunation shows › 9
It can show up as the pull toward the bigger picture: travel, study, or exploring beliefs to find what resonates as your own. The old map is up for revision, and honest questions serve you better than inherited answers.
lunation sign compact › full moon › aquarius
An Aquarius Full Moon shows you how the arrangement actually works. Saturn rules this sign, so attention turns to the responsibilities, limits, and old terms holding the plan together. The fixed signs are involved, so check your grip.
lunation sign compact › full moon › aries
An Aries Full Moon shows you where the line got crossed months ago. Mars rules this sign, so the surfacing runs hot, and the temperature marks the spot. Cardinal fire moves fast; say it before it collects.
lunation sign compact › full moon › cancer
A Cancer Full Moon presents the bill for the caretaking. The Moon is home here, so the tide runs high and pointed. Follow the feeling to its subject and tend to that.
lunation sign compact › full moon › capricorn
A Capricorn Full Moon delivers the invoice for the ambition. Saturn rules this sign, so the review is structural: what the role costs against what it returns. Cardinal earth endures; check what the endurance is for.
lunation sign compact › full moon › gemini
A Gemini Full Moon empties the drafts folder. Mercury rules this sign, so the release is verbal. Mutable air clears when it speaks; pick the one exchange that matters.
lunation sign compact › full moon › leo
A Leo Full Moon shows you where being seen went missing. The Sun rules this sign, so the subject is credit, warmth, and visibility. Fixed fire holds; let the effort be visible again.
lunation sign compact › full moon › libra
A Libra Full Moon shows you what the harmony costs. Venus rules this sign, so the deal underneath is the subject: who adjusts, who benefits, who went silent.
lunation sign compact › full moon › pisces
A Pisces Full Moon shows you what you have been absorbing without keeping score. Jupiter rules this sign, placing the focus on generosity and faith: where they nourish you, and where they cover for what you refuse to verify.
lunation sign compact › full moon › sagittarius
A Sagittarius Full Moon measures the distance between the belief and the calendar. Jupiter rules this sign, so the hunger for meaning rises. Mutable fire moves; pick the conviction that gets a date.
lunation sign compact › full moon › scorpio
A Scorpio Full Moon opens the sealed file. Mars rules this sign, so what surfaces was buried deliberately and kept its charge. Fixed water grips; loosen it enough to look.
lunation sign compact › full moon › taurus
A Taurus Full Moon shows you what you are actually holding. Venus rules this sign, so the body and the bank account give their reports. Fixed earth grips; notice where holding became bracing.
lunation sign compact › full moon › virgo
A Virgo Full Moon totals the upkeep. Mercury rules this sign, so the evidence arrives small and specific. The standards you maintain alone are the subject; decide which ones still earn it.
lunation sign compact › new moon › aquarius
An Aquarius New Moon redesigns the system on purpose. Saturn rules this sign, so the beginning is structural: name who carries what, and where the limits are, before the new version hardens.
lunation sign compact › new moon › aries
An Aries New Moon starts with the first move. Mars rules this sign, so the beginning needs action within days, not a better plan. The first step is the signature.
lunation sign compact › new moon › cancer
A Cancer New Moon begins with your own people and place. The Moon is in its own sign, so the start protects before it expands. Build the base; the reach comes later.
lunation sign compact › new moon › capricorn
A Capricorn New Moon starts with the load plan. Saturn rules this sign, so the beginning is a structure: a schedule, a responsibility, a cost accepted in advance.
lunation sign compact › new moon › gemini
A Gemini New Moon starts with a question. Mercury rules this sign, so the beginning is a message, a call, a first conversation. Contact comes before certainty.
lunation sign compact › new moon › leo
A Leo New Moon begins with what you want your name on. The Sun rules this sign, so the start needs real desire, not borrowed approval. Fixed energy is involved, so what you commit to now stays.
lunation sign compact › new moon › libra
A Libra New Moon starts as a two-person decision. Venus rules this sign, so the beginning is a stated deal, adjusted together. State the terms while everyone still likes each other.
lunation sign compact › new moon › pisces
A Pisces New Moon begins as an inclination, not a plan. Jupiter rules this sign, so even a quiet start carries size. Give it privacy and a rhythm, and let the meaning arrive on its own schedule.
lunation sign compact › new moon › sagittarius
A Sagittarius New Moon starts with a destination. Jupiter rules this sign, so the beginning needs a horizon, not a chore list. Aim far and date the first move.
lunation sign compact › new moon › scorpio
A Scorpio New Moon starts in private. Mars rules this sign, so the beginning is a pursuit: chosen completely, kept quiet, followed through.
lunation sign compact › new moon › taurus
A Taurus New Moon starts what is meant to last. Venus rules this sign, so the beginning must be sustainable, not heroic. Slow is the strategy, not the delay.
lunation sign compact › new moon › virgo
A Virgo New Moon starts small and practical on purpose. Mercury rules this sign, making the beginning a routine, not a speech: one fix, one boundary, one measurable change. What gets quietly repaired this month lasts.
lunation uranus layer › 1
Uranus in your 1st house adds a more personal element of change. Other people may notice that your direction, language, or presentation is changing before you have fully explained it.
lunation uranus layer › 10
Uranus in your 10th house moves the career ground: a role, a path, or a public identity shifts before the announcement is written.
lunation uranus layer › 11
Uranus in your 11th house reorganizes the circle: alliances shift overnight, group dynamics show their fault lines, and the people arriving now point to where you actually belong.
lunation uranus layer › 12
Uranus in your 12th house works in the dark: a private truth or long-running pattern breaks open before your conscious mind can talk you out of it.
lunation uranus layer › 2
Uranus in your 2nd house makes the money floor move: income, prices, or a resource you relied on shifts fast, and holding on out of fear proves different from security.
lunation uranus layer › 3
Uranus in your 3rd house reroutes the information: news arrives without warning, plans change mid-errand, and one honest conversation sends the situation down a new track.
lunation uranus layer › 4
Uranus in your 4th house shakes the home base: living arrangements, family roles, or old ideas of where you belong are up for a real redesign.
lunation uranus layer › 5
Uranus in your 5th house changes what pulls you: a sudden attraction, a strange inspiration, or an appetite for pleasure that interrupts the tidy routine.
lunation uranus layer › 6
Uranus in your 6th house makes rigid discipline impossible: the body or the workload pushes back against the current system, and flexibility starts outperforming control.
lunation uranus layer › 7
Uranus in your 7th house brings the freedom question into close bonds: a partnership either makes space for the real versions of both people or strains under the fake harmony.
lunation uranus layer › 8
Uranus in your 8th house speeds up the shared layer: a financial or emotional agreement with another person moves faster than either of you planned.
lunation uranus layer › 9
Uranus in your 9th house retires an old certainty: new information lands, and a belief or long-term plan you kept defending stops holding its shape.
lunation week layer
This week, the missing information arrives, someone gives their answer, or the practical cost of the plan becomes harder to ignore.

friend view

It just becomes the ground you grow from instead of the place you hide.

transit house retro overlay › jupiter
Jupiter runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the growth turns inward for a stretch: gains consolidate rather than multiply, and the opportunity that matters circles back for a second look. Develop what you already hold; the expansion resumes on schedule.
friend view
Jupiter runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their growth turns inward for a stretch: gains consolidate rather than multiply, and the opportunity that matters circles back for a second look. The gains develop best from what they already hold; the expansion resumes on schedule.
transit house retro overlay › mars
Mars runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the drive turns inward and doubles back: stalled projects resurface, old frustrations ask to be finished properly, and force works better revised than repeated. Aim the energy at completing what is already open.
friend view
Mars runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their drive turns inward and doubles back: stalled projects resurface, old frustrations ask to be finished properly, and force works better revised than repeated. The energy pays best aimed at what is already open.
transit house retro overlay › mercury
Mercury runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the weeks double back on themselves: messages resurface, plans revise, and the same conversation comes around twice. The second pass is the editing pass; revise rather than redo, and reconfirm anything with a date on it.
friend view
Mercury runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their weeks double back: messages resurface, plans revise, and the same conversation comes around twice. The second pass is the editing pass for them, and anything with a date on it deserves a reconfirm.
transit house retro overlay › saturn
Saturn runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the structures get tested from the inside: commitments come up for review, and the shortcut taken earlier surfaces for proper repair. Rebuild what wobbles; the inspection ends and the building resumes.
friend view
Saturn runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so their structures get tested from the inside: commitments come up for review, and the shortcut taken earlier surfaces for proper repair. What wobbles gets rebuilt; the inspection ends and the building resumes.
transit house retro overlay › venus
Venus runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the window reviews instead of previews: old names resurface, tastes get second-guessed, and what you valued last year comes up for reappraisal. Let the reviews finish before making the purchases and promises permanent.
friend view
Venus runs retrograde during part of this crossing, so the window reviews instead of previews for them: old names resurface, tastes get second-guessed, and what they valued last year comes up for reappraisal. The purchases and promises hold better made after the reviews finish.
